short_description: Short in stature, but not in warfare.
lore: The mountain your people called home has been overtaken by a creature of the night, forcing you to seek the power to reclaim what is yours.
passive_description: Cannot be staggered.
active_description: Invulnerable for a few seconds.
building_style: Stone halls, carved runes

short_description: Ancient and elegant, but deadly nonetheless.
lore: A history of pride in your rulers has led your people to the brink of collapse. Abandoning your decaying city, you seek the power to create a new start.
passive_description: Has more god godly gift choices.
active_description: Create a range of magic damage (different animation depending on god)
building_style: Wooden and elegant.

short_description: Resilient and adaptable.
lore: The nobles of your kingdom could not stop fighting over power once the last king died. Brutal wars forced your people to seek the power to defend your own.
passive_description: Gains XP faster.
active_description: Boost to all stats for a time
building_style: Practical, stone and wood.
palette_colors: Wool brown, iron grey, crimson banners

short_description: Animal nature focused and pointed to war.
lore: Constantly looking for the next conquest, your people seek the power to conquer.
passive_description: Regains a little health when killing an enemy.
active_description: A fury of attacks
building_style: Flat-roofed mudbrick houses, pylon gates and obelisks (user, 2026-10-31: Ancient Egypt)
palette_colors: Sand, linen white, lapis blue, gold

short_description: Rulers of the sky.
lore: The ever-evolving ecosystem has forced your people to adjust to the intrusion of others. You seek the power to stay free.
passive_description: Can fly.
active_description: Scream attack that pushes enemies back
building_style: On stilts

short_description: A tribal people who are masters of the hunt.
lore: You were exiled from your last home by a corrupt ruler. You seek the power to defeat those who wish you harm.
passive_description: Gains warriors for the final battle regardless of settlement choices.
active_description: Huge damage boost
building_style: Yurts and cavalry
palette_colors: Olive skin, felt red, horse-hair black

short_description: Crafty and adaptable, can be found almost everywhere.
lore: Often looked down upon, you seek the power to stake your own claim.
passive_description: Has a chance to not be seen by enemies.
active_description: Turns an enemy into a mushroom for a time
building_style: Industrious, built into the surrounding nature.

short_description: These ancient beings make the waterways and swamps their home.
lore: Wishing to maintain your old ways, you seek the power to preserve.
passive_description: Swims rapids and deep lakes no other race can cross, and swims 60% faster.
active_description: Heal to full health and do extra damage for a time
building_style: Stone temples with gold

short_description: Wild and carefree, defenders of nature.
lore: Your people travel the land in defense of nature. You seek the power to regrow.
passive_description: Summons archer companions when in battle (relative to number of enemies).
active_description: Can summon creatures to fight for a time
building_style: Stables almost, long houses

short_description: Strong people who are much more than their maze-dwelling cousins.
lore: Misunderstood by many, you seek the power to define your future.
passive_description: Can destroy elements by just moving through them.
active_description: Charge attack for big damage
duration: Until player stops pressing active button or character hits wall.
building_style: Mud huts and tents

short_description: Shepherds of the forest.
lore: Nature animated, you seek the power to protect your herd.
passive_description: Chance to not take damage.
active_description: Roots enemies in place and they take damage
building_style: Trees
palette_colors: Bark brown, leaf green, amber sap

short_description: Not biblical, but as close to divine as they come.
lore: Arrogance? Maybe, but your people are the closest living thing to divine. You seek the power to spread light.
passive_description: Can see more of the map.
active_description: Dive attack that also heals player and allies
building_style: Marble temples, red tile roofs and columns (user, 2026-10-31: Ancient Rome)

short_description: Not evil per se, they just have an affinity for the dark.
lore: Of dubious origins, you seek the power to carve a future for your people.
passive_description: Does fire damage innately.
active_description: Fire beam for big damage
building_style: Dark but elegant

short_description: Small, quick and immune to the plagues they carry.
lore: Driven from the sewers beneath a dying city, your people survived the sickness that killed everyone above. You seek the power to never be stepped on again.
passive_description: Immune to Poison. Enemies that hit you in melee have a 15% chance to be Poisoned.
active_description: Release a carpet of rats that Poisons every enemy it runs over.
building_style: Burrows and patchwork shanties built into old ruins.

short_description: Proud snow monkeys of the mountain hot springs, bound by honor and ritual.
lore: An endless winter froze your hot springs and buried your castle town under the snow. You came down into the valley seeking the power to outlast the cold.
passive_description: Immune to slows. Take 20% less damage from Ice and Water.
active_description: A lightning-fast draw cut along an 8 m line that freezes everything it hits for 2 s.
building_style: Wooden castle towns, pagodas and steaming hot springs.
palette_colors: Snow-white fur, red faces, indigo and vermilion lacquer

short_description: Striped, tiger-like hunters of the deep jungle, as graceful as they are deadly.
lore: Your jungle kingdom of stepwells and rock-cut temples was swallowed by a creeping blight. You crossed the mountains seeking the power to reclaim the jungle throne.
passive_description: Your first hit after sprinting leaps onto the target and deals 30% extra damage.
active_description: A roar that staggers every enemy within 8 m and makes them flee for 2 s.
building_style: Rock-cut temples, stupas and stepwells under the jungle canopy.
palette_colors: Tiger orange, black stripes, jade and gold

short_description: Silent white-feathered hunters of the frozen north, patient and sharp-eyed.
lore: The sea ice your people have hunted on for generations has begun to break apart. You came south seeking the power to save your home.
passive_description: Your first hit on an enemy that isn't fighting you deals 30% extra damage.
active_description: A freezing gust that knocks back and slows every enemy within 8 m.
building_style: Snow-block domes, whalebone frames and drying racks.
palette_colors: Snow white, caribou tan, ivory, deep blue

short_description: Huge, proud and slow to anger, with long memories and strong family bonds.
lore: Raiders drove off your herds and burned your homesteads. You marched into the valley seeking the power to protect your kin.
passive_description: Knockdowns can't stop you, and you take 15% less damage while standing still.
active_description: A stampeding stomp that knocks down every enemy within 7 m.
building_style: Domed beehive huts of woven grass around round cattle kraals.
palette_colors: Slate grey, cowhide black and white, ochre, beadwork red

short_description: Scaled, long-lived scholars and generals from a land of rivers and ancient dynasties.
lore: Your empire's rivers ran dry when the old dragons fell silent. You came seeking the power to bring the rains back.
passive_description: Your magic hits slowly build up a charge that makes your next hit stronger.
active_description: A breath of storm that blasts everything in a line 10 m ahead of you.
building_style: Curved tiled roofs, pagodas and moon gates.
palette_colors: Jade scales, imperial yellow, vermilion lacquer

short_description: Quick, big-eared desert travelers who know every well and mountain pass.
lore: The caravan roads your people have walked for a thousand years are closed by war. You seek the power to keep them open.
passive_description: You hear danger coming: you dodge farther and sprint on sand without slowing.
active_description: A burst of speed for a few seconds in a swirl of sand that blinds nearby enemies.
building_style: Mudbrick kasbahs with tall decorated towers.
